svg.title: Coding agents: see it first, follow it live
svg.desc: One launch in four steps. A card's Claude button opens the launch options for acme-org/api #412, already on what the item's settings choose: Claude as the agent, the Review prompt from the app default, the work profile, Opus from the repository's default, High effort from the org's default, and a worktree from the app default, with plan mode ticked for this launch, a preview, and buttons to save the choices as the default for api or all of acme-org, Cancel, and Open in Claude. The terminal opens in the item's own worktree, ~/projects/.nilbox/worktrees/api/pr-412, with the Review prompt loaded. Back on the card, the session is followed live: Claude is on it in a new worktree, then Claude needs approval with a Show terminal button, then Claude's done and the review is yours. Beside it, the guard rails: an outside contributor's pull request that changes agent configuration carries a red chip and a locked agent button, starts in plan mode whatever the profile says, and waits until you confirm.

g.text: Each card's launch options open on the item's own settings, so you see what will run first.
Claude Code or Codex starts in the item's own worktree, and its card follows the session.
